Nyi Bae Oong (倪培鵬)
Sicu Shan (蕭山)                      D.S. Makaroff
11.40 p.m.          24/10/34          Clerk Pang Kuo Liang.

My name is Nyi Bae Oong, age 25, native of Siau
Shan, Chekiang, Single, employed as a weaver in the
Sung Hwa (修華) Silk Weaving Factory, No. 139 Lane
1143 East Yuhang Road.    I am at present living at
No. 25, Lane 1143, East Yuhang Road.
    My education commenced in a private school in
my native place at the age of 8. I left school at the
age of 13 and was idle for two years and at the age
of 15 I became an apprentice in a candle shop in my
native place.    After 3 years of apprenticeship in
the candle shop, I entered a silk weaving factory in
Shaoshing (紹興) also as an apprentice, which I left
about one year later as result of the closure of the
factory due to business failure, and was engaged in
a native silk weaving concern in Shaoshing.    I
remained in this position for one year and then left
for Shanghai.    At that time I was 20 years old.    I
arrived in Shanghai in July 1929 and in August of
the same year I obtained my present employment as
an apprentice; at that time the factory was located
at No. 3 King Sing Li (景星里), Kung Woo Road,
Chapei and removed to the present address in February 1930.
    I am not a Communist.    I am not affiliated with
any labour or political cliques.
    This is my true statement.

                Signed:    Nyi Bae Oong.
pages.zh:
倪培鹏（Nyi Bae Oong）
萧山（Sicu Shan）                      警佐 Makaroff
晚上 11:40          1934年10月24日          书记员 Pang Kuo Liang。

我叫倪培鹏，25岁，浙江萧山人，未婚，在东余杭路1143弄139号修华（Sung Hwa）丝织厂担任织工。我目前居住在东余杭路1143弄25号。
我8岁时在家乡的一所私塾开始受教育。13岁辍学，闲居两年，15岁时在家乡的一家蜡烛店当学徒。在蜡烛店学徒三年后，我进入绍兴（Shaoshing）的一家丝织厂也是做学徒，约一年后因工厂经营失败倒闭而离开，并在绍兴的一家本地丝织企业任职。我在这个职位上待了一年，然后前往上海。当时我20岁。我于1929年7月抵达上海，同年8月获得目前的学徒职位；当时工厂位于闸北公和路景星里（King Sing Li）3号，并于1930年2月迁至现址。
我不是共产党人。我不隶属于任何劳工或政治派系。
这是我的真实陈述。

                签名：    倪培鹏。

Tsiang Zae Sih (蒋瑞锡)
Yah Zah (石), Chekiang          D.S. Makaroff
11.40 p.m.           24/10/34           Clerk Fang Kio Liang.

My name is Tsiang Zae Sih, age 20, native of Yah Zah,
Chekiang, single, employed as apprentice-weaver at the
Sung Hwa (勝華) Silk Weaving Factory, No. 139,Lane 1143,
East Yuhang Road. I am at present living at No. 25,Lane
1143 East Yuhang Road.

I commenced my education at a primary school in Yah Zah
at the age of 7 and left school in June 1928. I remained
with my father at my native place until Spring of 1929
when I left for Shanghai and took up apprenticeship in
the Wei Foong (偉丰) Silk Weaving Factory situated at
No. 12 Tien Yeu Li (天佑里), Hai Chong Road, Chapel.
I remained in this factory until December of the same year
when the factory closed down owing to business failure.
I then obtained my present position with the Sung Hwa
Silk Factory owned by Mr. King You Tuh (金有德) who
formerly was the manager of the defunct Wei Foong Factory.

I am not a Communist. I have never taken part in any
labour activities nor am I interested in political affairs.
This is my true statement.

Signed:      Tsiang Zae Sih.
pages.zh:
蒋瑞锡（Tsiang Zae Sih）
石碶（Yah Zah），浙江          警佐 Makaroff
晚上 11:40           1934年10月24日           书记员 Fang Kio Liang。

我叫蒋瑞锡，20岁，浙江石碶人，未婚，在东余杭路1143弄139号胜华（Sung Hwa）丝织厂担任学徒织工。我目前居住在东余杭路1143弄25号。

我7岁时在石碶的一所小学开始受教育，于1928年6月辍学。我一直留在家乡父亲身边，直到1929年春前往上海，在海崇路天佑里（Tien Yeu Li）12号的伟丰（Wei Foong）丝织厂当学徒。我在这家工厂一直工作到同年12月，工厂因经营失败而倒闭。随后，我在金有德（King You Tuh）先生拥有的胜华丝厂获得了目前的职位，金先生曾是已倒闭的伟丰厂的经理。

我不是共产党人。我从未参与任何劳工活动，也对政治事务不感兴趣。
这是我的真实陈述。

签名：      蒋瑞锡。
